faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi (IIT Mandi) for a temporary project associate position located in Kamand, Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Mandi recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Project Associate, with a total of 1 vacancy announced under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a B.Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with a minimum of 70% marks or 7.0 CGPA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate position will receive a monthly salary of INR 20,000 as per the institutional norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application along with the required CV via the online Google Form is 30 October 2026 before 10 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Mandi recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online through the designated Google Form link provided in the official project notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the project for this position?
faq.answer: The total duration of the project is 12 months, and the renewal of services will depend upon satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of initial shortlisting based on candidate qualifications and requirements, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to be paid in the official notification for this temporary project associate role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of IIT Mandi?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi at https://iitmandi.ac.in for further details and updates.
